sentences.en: Crowberries are little bluish-black bitter berries that grow on shrubs.
sentences.zh: 越橘是生长在灌木上的小而带苦味的蓝黑色浆果。

sentences.en: "What is it?" "Well, you see, I wanted the shrubs pruned."
sentences.zh: “这是什么？”“嗯，你看，我想修剪一下灌木。”

sentences.en: The landscape was dotted with green and grey shrubs.
sentences.zh: 这片景色中点缀着绿色和灰色的灌木。

senses.zh: 灌木；（尤指搀朗姆酒或白兰地的）果汁甜酒；<美>果汁露酒
